title: A reptilian being appears in Barbara Lamb's living room

tellings.quote: then one afternoon she she came out of her garden into her house and here was this reptilian guy

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, Dan Sheehan, retells something a woman named Barbara Lamb told him, mentioning the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack along the way. According to Sheehan, Lamb said that one afternoon she came in from her garden and found a reptile-like being standing in her house. If true, it would mean such beings can turn up in an ordinary home.
